annotations.title: Wisdom.
annotations.text: As wel in these Sapiential bookes, as in other holie Scriptures, and sacred writers, the vvord vvisdom hath three significations. [1] Sometimes it importeth the Diuine Attribute called Gods wisdom; sometimes supernatural wisdom geuen to men by the Holie Ghost; and sometimes it signifieth mere humane vvisdom, gotten by the natural light of reason and mans industrie. [2] The first, as likevvise other Diuine Attributes, Gods Povvre, Goodnes, Iustice, Truth, Mercie and the like, are not qualities, or other accidents in God, as the same termes signifie in creatures. For in God there is no Accident, but al in him is this Diuine Substance and Essence, vvhose diuers Excellences are called by such names as mans capacitie can better conceiue: and so Gods vvisdom is God himselfe: [3] and is appropried to the second Person of the blessed Trinitie, as Povvre is appropried to God the Father, and Goodnes to the Holie Ghost. In this sense: chap. 4. v. 16. is saide: Our Lord by vvisdom founded the earth &c. The second is called (Sap. 3. v. 25.) the vapore of Gods povvre, and a pure emanation (or influence) of the glorie of Almightie God, and so is a participation of Diuine increated wisdom called also diuine, according to a certaine anologie, or similitude of Gods owne wisdom, and is the principal gifte of the Holie Ghost, [4] by vvhich God is rightly knovvne, and duly serued, including al other supernal giftes and vertues, vvherof is treated in these bookes, and so vvhich al men are inuited, vvith assured promise of celestial and eternal revvard. [5] The third vvisdome is mere humane, gotten by natural vvitte and studie, such as Philosophers haue, knovving manie truthes, but mixt vvith manie errors, and much ignorance, truly called vvorldlie vvisdom, seruing only for this vvorld. But the second kind, vvhich is as a sparkecle of Gods vvisdom, maketh men, othervvise ignorant and of smal capacitie, rightly vvise in dede, the true seruants of God, and enheriters of the kingdom of heauen, as these bookes do most copiously teach.

notes.text: Diuine Attributes are not qualities in God, but his substance.
VVisdom the gifte of the Holie Ghost.

annotations.title: Because I called and you refused.
annotations.text: <mn>[1]</mn> God voutsaffeth foure benefites of grace to euerie man, al necessarie and sufficient for his saluation: <mn>[2]</mn> 1. He calleth al by preaching, or good inspiration. <mn>[3]</mn> 2. He offereth helpe. <mn>[4]</mn> 3. He instructeth the ignorant what is good, that they may choose it if they wil. <mn>[5]</mn> 4 And reprehendeth euil, that they may shunne it. They therfore that neglect this manifold grace in this life, shal without al remedie be damned, being to late to repent in an other world. For then they shal crie and not be heard. v. 28.

annotations.title: But he that shal heare me.
annotations.text: Contrariwise those that accept Gods grace, and cooperate therwith, shal haue eternal rest and ioy. <mn>◦</mn> The very same, which S. Paul teacheth, 2. Cor. 5. v. 10. Euerie one shal receiue the proper thinges of the bodie, according as he hath done, either good or euil.
